<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow"><meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
<title>Collective funnel · Beforest</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
@font-face{font-family:"ABC Arizona Flare";src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format("woff");font-weight:300;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"ABC Arizona Flare";src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format("woff");font-weight:400;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:"ABC Arizona Flare";src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format("woff");font-weight:500;font-display:swap}
:root{--bark:#342e29;--cream:#fdfbf7;--paper:#f7f2ea;--rust:#86312b;--peach:#ffc083;--forest:#0d2818;--moss:#344736;--line:#ebe4d9;--muted:#8a8078;
--serif:"ABC Arizona Flare",Georgia,serif;--sans:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--bark);font:400 14px/1.55 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 32px 72px}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:22px}
.eyebrow{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
h1{font:300 44px/1.05 var(--serif);margin:6px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.6px}
h2{font:400 20px/1.2 var(--serif);margin:0 0 16px}
.status{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);flex-wrap:wrap}.status b{font-weight:500;color:var(--bark)}
.bar-f{margin-bottom:22px}
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--paper);border-radius:999px;padding:3px;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}.seg::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.seg button{border:0;background:none;font:500 12.5px var(--sans);color:var(--muted);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.seg button.on{background:#fff;color:var(--bark);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
.hero{background:var(--forest);color:var(--cream);border-radius:20px;padding:30px 34px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero .n{font:300 76px/0.9 var(--serif)}.hero .l{opacity:.75;font-size:13px}
.hero .run{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;opacity:.9}.hero .run b{color:var(--peach);font-weight:500}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:22px 24px;min-width:0}
.k .t{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.k .n{font:300 40px/1.05 var(--serif);margin:10px 0 6px}
.k .s{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
.f{display:grid;grid-template-columns:140px 1fr 64px 64px;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0}
.f .bg{height:8px;background:var(--paper);border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.f .bg i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--moss);border-radius:9px}
.f.key .bg i{background:var(--rust)}.f.key span:first-child{font-weight:500}
.f .n{text-align:right;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.f .c{text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.f.na .n{color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;font-size:12px}
.thread{grid-column:2/5;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:-6px 0 4px;line-height:1.55}
.note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;line-height:1.6}
footer{margin-top:30px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
footer p{margin:2px 0}
@media(max-width:860px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.two,.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:600px){.wrap{padding:24px 16px 48px}h1{font-size:34px}header{gap:12px;padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero{padding:22px;gap:18px;border-radius:16px}.hero .n{font-size:60px}.kpis{gap:10px}.card{padding:18px 16px;border-radius:14px}
.k .n{font-size:30px}.f{grid-template-columns:92px 1fr 48px 48px;gap:8px;font-size:13px}.f .c{font-size:11px}.thread{grid-column:1/5}}
.picker{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.dates{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.dates input{font:500 12.5px var(--sans);color:var(--bark);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px}
.explain{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.6}.explain b{color:var(--bark);font-weight:500}
.warn{background:#fff6ec;border:1px solid #f3dcc2;color:#7a4a1c;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.55}
.stale{color:var(--rust)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <header>
    <div><div class="eyebrow">Beforest · Sprint</div><h1>Collective funnel</h1></div>
    <div class="status" id="status"></div>
  </header>
  <div class="picker">
    <div class="seg" id="presets"></div>
    <div class="dates"><input type="date" id="from" aria-label="From"> → <input type="date" id="to" aria-label="To"></div>
  </div>
  <p class="explain" id="explain"></p>
  <div class="bar-f"><div class="seg" id="tabs" role="tablist"></div></div>
  <div id="warn"></div>
  <div id="app"></div>
  <footer id="foot"></footer>
</div>
<script>
const D = __FUNNEL_DATA__;
// Collective funnel (live): sums the per-day data for any date range. Runs in the browser; also loadable in node for tests.
const COLLECTIVES = ["Mumbai", "Hammiyala", "Poomaale 2.0", "Poomaale 1.0", "Hyderabad", "Bhopal"];
const VIVEK = new Set(["Poomaale 1.0", "Hyderabad", "Bhopal"]);
const STAGES = ["New", "Attempting", "Connected", "Interested", "Meeting Booked", "Not a Fit", "Unresponsive"];
function addDays(d, n) { const x = new Date(d + "T00:00:00Z"); x.setUTCDate(x.getUTCDate() + n); return x.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
function daysBetween(a, b) { return Math.round((new Date(b + "T00:00:00Z") - new Date(a + "T00:00:00Z")) / 864e5) + 1; }
function fmtDay(d) { const [y, m, dd] = d.split("-").map(Number); return `${dd} ${["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"][m - 1]}`; }
function periods(days) { // sorted unique ISO days -> "22 Sep – 9 Oct · 31 Oct – 5 Nov"
  const out = []; let s = null, p = null;
  for (const d of days) { if (p && addDays(p, 1) === d) { p = d; continue; } if (s) out.push([s, p]); s = p = d; }
  if (s) out.push([s, p]);
  return out.map(([a, b]) => a === b ? fmtDay(a) : `${fmtDay(a)} – ${fmtDay(b)}`).join(" · ");
}
function compute(D, a, b) {
  const inR = (d) => d >= a && d <= b, R = {};
  for (const c of ["All", ...COLLECTIVES]) R[c] = { ads: {}, adDays: {}, campaigns: [], channels: {}, sources: {}, stages: {}, n: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], fills: 0, repeat: 0, liForms: 0, liInCrm: 0, vivek: VIVEK.has(c) };
  const both = (c, f) => { f(R[c]); f(R.All); };
  const ad = (c, src, date, spend, imp, clk) => both(c, (x) => { const a2 = x.ads[src] ??= [0, 0, 0]; a2[0] += spend; a2[1] += imp; a2[2] += clk; if (spend > 0) (x.adDays[src] ??= new Set()).add(date); });
  for (const [d, c, s, i, k] of D.meta?.rows ?? []) if (inR(d)) ad(c, "Meta", d, s, i, k);
  for (const [d, c, s, i, k, l] of D.linkedin?.rows ?? []) if (inR(d)) { ad(c, "LinkedIn", d, s, i, k); both(c, (x) => x.liForms += l); }
  for (const [c, list] of Object.entries(D.meta?.campaigns ?? {})) R[c].campaigns.push(...list);
  for (const [c, list] of Object.entries(D.linkedin?.campaigns ?? {})) R[c].campaigns.push(...list.map((n) => "LinkedIn “" + n + "”"));
  for (const [d, c, ch, n] of D.ga?.rows ?? []) if (inR(d)) both(c, (x) => x.channels[ch] = (x.channels[ch] ?? 0) + n);
  for (const [c, d, src, fills, rep, st, con, c1, mb, mh] of D.leads?.rows ?? []) {
    // Fills: the first fill counts on the enquiry date, repeat fills by the same person on their latest submission date.
    if (src === "Typeform") { if (inR(d)) both(c, (x) => x.fills += 1); if (fills > 1 && rep && inR(rep)) both(c, (x) => { x.fills += fills - 1; x.repeat += fills - 1; }); }
    if (!inR(d)) continue;
    both(c, (x) => { x.sources[src] = (x.sources[src] ?? 0) + 1; x.stages[st] = (x.stages[st] ?? 0) + 1; x.n[4]++; x.n[5] += con; x.n[6] += c1; x.n[7] += mb; x.n[8] += mh; if (src === "LinkedIn") x.liInCrm++; });
  }
  for (const x of Object.values(R)) {
    const sum = (j) => Object.values(x.ads).reduce((t, v) => t + v[j], 0);
    x.spend = sum(0); x.n[0] = sum(1); x.n[1] = sum(2); x.n[2] = Object.values(x.channels).reduce((t, v) => t + v, 0); x.n[3] = x.fills;
    x.run = Object.entries(x.adDays).map(([s, set]) => [s, [...set].sort()]);
    const all = new Set(); x.run.forEach(([, ds]) => ds.forEach((d) => all.add(d))); x.adDayCount = all.size;
  }
  return R;
}
if (typeof module !== "undefined" && typeof window === "undefined") module.exports = { compute, periods, addDays, daysBetween, COLLECTIVES, STAGES };

const num = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN");
const inr = n => "₹" + num(n);
const list = o => Object.entries(o).filter(([, v]) => v).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${num(v)}`).join(" · ");
const pc = (v, p) => { const x = v / p * 100; return x === 0 ? "0%" : (x < 1 ? x.toFixed(2) : x < 10 ? x.toFixed(1) : x.toFixed(0)) + "%"; };
const STAGE_LABEL = { "Not a Fit": "Not a fit (Red)", "Unresponsive": "Unresponsive (Yellow)", "Meeting Booked": "Meeting booked" };
const VIVEK_GAP = "2026-10-24";
const S = { tab: "All", from: null, to: null };
const fromEl = document.getElementById("from"), toEl = document.getElementById("to");
fromEl.min = toEl.min = D.from; fromEl.max = toEl.max = D.to;
const monthStart = d => d.slice(0, 8) + "01";
const PRESETS = [
  ["Last 7 days", () => [addDays(D.to, -6), D.to]], ["Last 30 days", () => [addDays(D.to, -29), D.to]], ["Last 45 days", () => [addDays(D.to, -44), D.to]],
  ["Last 90 days", () => [addDays(D.to, -89), D.to]], ["This month", () => [monthStart(D.to), D.to]],
  ["Last month", () => { const e = addDays(monthStart(D.to), -1); return [monthStart(e), e]; }], ["Since 1 Aug", () => [D.from, D.to]],
];
const clamp = d => d < D.from ? D.from : d > D.to ? D.to : d;
const presets = document.getElementById("presets");
PRESETS.forEach(([label, f]) => { const b = document.createElement("button"); b.textContent = label; b.onclick = () => { const [a, z] = f(); setRange(a, z); }; presets.appendChild(b); });
const tabs = document.getElementById("tabs");
["All", ...COLLECTIVES].forEach(k => { const b = document.createElement("button"); b.textContent = k; b.setAttribute("role", "tab"); b.onclick = () => { S.tab = k; render(); }; tabs.appendChild(b); });
fromEl.onchange = () => setRange(fromEl.value || S.from, S.to);
toEl.onchange = () => setRange(S.from, toEl.value || S.to);
function setRange(a, z) { a = clamp(a); z = clamp(z); if (a > z) [a, z] = [z, a]; S.from = a; S.to = z; render(); }
function steps(rows) {
  const top = rows[0].n || 1; let prev = null;
  return rows.map((s, i) => {
    const na = s.n == null;
    const c = na || prev == null ? "" : s.n > prev ? "+ other" : prev === 0 ? "" : pc(s.n, prev);
    const row = `<div class="f${i === rows.length - 1 ? " key" : ""}${na ? " na" : ""}"><span>${s.label}</span>
      <div class="bg"><i style="width:${na ? 0 : Math.max(s.n ? 1.5 : 0, Math.min(100, s.n / top * 100))}%"></i></div>
      <span class="n">${na ? "–" : num(s.n)}</span><span class="c">${c}</span>
      ${s.thread ? `<div class="thread">${s.thread}</div>` : ""}</div>`;
    if (!na) prev = s.n; return row;
  }).join("");
}
function render() {
  [...tabs.children].forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", b.textContent === S.tab));
  const days = daysBetween(S.from, S.to);
  [...presets.children].forEach((b, i) => { const [a, z] = PRESETS[i][1](); b.classList.toggle("on", a === S.from && z === S.to); });
  fromEl.value = S.from; toEl.value = S.to;
  try { history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + new URLSearchParams({ tab: S.tab, from: S.from, to: S.to })); } catch (e) {}
  const R = compute(D, S.from, S.to), f = R[S.tab], n = f.n, srcs = Object.keys(f.ads), multi = srcs.length > 1;
  document.getElementById("explain").innerHTML =
    `<b>${fmtDay(S.from)} ${S.from.slice(0, 4)} → ${fmtDay(S.to)} ${S.to.slice(0, 4)}</b> (${days} day${days > 1 ? "s" : ""}). ` +
    `Ads, page visits and form fills: what happened on these dates. Leads → meetings: the people who enquired on these dates, and how far each has got <b>as of now</b>.`;
  const warn = [];
  if (S.to === D.to) warn.push(`${fmtDay(D.to)} is still in progress. Google Analytics page visits for today arrive a few hours late.`);
  if ((S.tab === "All" || f.vivek) && S.from < VIVEK_GAP) warn.push(`Hyderabad, Poomaale 1.0 and Bhopal: some enquiries from before 24 Oct stayed in Vivek's old-lead sheet and never reached Zoho, so they are not counted here (for 22 Sep – 5 Nov that is 7 Hyderabad leads).`);
  document.getElementById("warn").innerHTML = warn.map(w => `<div class="warn">${w}</div>`).join("");
  const by = j => multi ? srcs.map(s => `${s} ${num(f.ads[s][j])}`).join(" · ") : "";
  const runTxt = f.run.length ? f.run.map(([s, ds]) => `${s} ads ran ${periods(ds)}`).join("<br>") + ` <span style="opacity:.75">(${f.adDayCount} of ${days} days with spend)</span>` : "No ad spend in this period.";
  const ads = [
    { label: "Ad impressions", n: n[0], thread: by(1) },
    { label: "Ad link clicks", n: n[1], thread: by(2) + (f.ads.LinkedIn ? " · LinkedIn clicks open LinkedIn's own lead form, not the page" : "") },
    { label: "Page visits", n: n[2], thread: Object.keys(f.channels).length ? "From " + list(f.channels) : "" },
    { label: "Typeform fills", n: n[3], thread: f.repeat ? `Includes ${num(f.repeat)} repeat fill${f.repeat > 1 ? "s" : ""} by the same person` : "" },
  ];
  const stages = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(f.stages).map(([k, v]) => [STAGE_LABEL[k] || k, v]));
  const sales = [
    { label: "Leads", n: n[4], thread: (n[4] ? "From " + list(f.sources) : "") + (f.liForms ? ` (LinkedIn lead forms: ${num(f.liForms)} submitted, ${num(f.liInCrm)} in the CRM)` : "") + (n[4] ? "<br>Stage now: " + list(stages) : "") },
    { label: "Contacted", n: n[5], thread: "Called, messaged on WhatsApp/email, or moved past New" },
    { label: "Call #1 booked", n: n[6], thread: f.vivek ? "Vivek calls leads directly and rarely logs a Call 1 date" : S.tab === "All" ? "Vivek's collectives rarely log a Call 1 date" : "Call 1 date filled in" },
    { label: "Meeting #1 booked", n: n[7], thread: "Meeting #1 date filled in (some may be in the future); cancelled ones left out" },
    { label: "Meeting #1 held", n: n[8], thread: "Meeting Notes written (sheet, until 11 Nov) or lead converted to a deal in Zoho" },
  ];
  const split = multi ? srcs.map(s => `${s} ${inr(f.ads[s][0])}`).join(" + ") : srcs[0] || "No ads";
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    `<section class="hero"><div><div class="l">Meeting #1 held</div><div class="n">${num(n[8])}</div>
       <div class="l">${num(n[7])} booked · from ${num(n[4])} leads · ${inr(f.spend)} ad spend</div></div>
       <div class="run">${S.tab === "All" ? "Ad run dates are on each collective's tab." : runTxt}</div></section>
     <div class="kpis">
       <div class="card k"><div class="t">Ad spend</div><div class="n">${inr(f.spend)}</div><div class="s">${split}${f.adDayCount < days && S.tab !== "All" ? ` · ads ran ${f.adDayCount} of ${days} days` : ""}</div></div>
       <div class="card k"><div class="t">Spend per lead</div><div class="n">${n[4] ? inr(f.spend / n[4]) : "–"}</div><div class="s">${num(n[4])} leads, all sources</div></div>
       <div class="card k"><div class="t">Spend per meeting held</div><div class="n">${n[8] ? inr(f.spend / n[8]) : "–"}</div><div class="s">${num(n[8])} held · ${n[7] ? inr(f.spend / n[7]) : "–"} per booked</div></div>
       <div class="card k"><div class="t">Click-through</div><div class="n">${n[0] ? pc(n[1], n[0]) : "–"}</div><div class="s">${num(n[1])} clicks of ${num(n[0])}</div></div>
     </div>
     <div class="two">
       <div class="card"><h2>Ads to enquiries</h2>${steps(ads)}</div>
       <div class="card"><h2>Enquiries to meetings</h2>${steps(sales)}</div>
     </div>`;
  const sk = D.leads?.skipped || {};
  document.getElementById("foot").innerHTML =
    `<p>% = share of the step above. “+ other” = this step also takes in people from other routes, listed under it.</p>
     <p>Page visits = Google Analytics sessions that opened the collective's page. “Meta ads” = sessions carrying our Meta ad tags; it sits a little below ad link clicks because some people leave before the page loads.</p>
     <p>Leads, stages, calls and meetings come from Zoho CRM (Sprint Lead layout), the place the team updates since 11 Nov. The source of each lead and Meeting Notes from before 11 Nov come from the Sprint and Vivek sheets.
       ${sk["counted from sheet only (not in Zoho)"] ? `${sk["counted from sheet only (not in Zoho)"]} leads are in the sheet but not in Zoho and are counted from the sheet.` : ""}
       Left out: ${sk["team test entry"] || 0} team test entries, ${sk["no enquiry date (imported deal)"] || 0} older deals imported into Zoho without an enquiry date.</p>
     <p>Typeform fills are counted from the leads (one per person, plus repeat fills on their latest date).</p>
     ${f.campaigns.length ? `<p>Campaigns: ${f.campaigns.join(", ")}.</p>` : ""}`;
  const t = s => s ? new Date(s).toLocaleString("en-IN", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata", day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false }) : "never";
  const bad = Object.entries(D.sources || {}).filter(([, v]) => !v.ok);
  document.getElementById("status").innerHTML = `<span>Updated <b>${t(D.built_at)} IST</b></span><span>Refreshes every 15 min</span>` +
    (bad.length ? `<span class="stale">Couldn't refresh ${bad.map(([k, v]) => `${{ meta: "Meta", ga: "Google Analytics", linkedin: "LinkedIn", leads: "leads" }[k] || k} (last good ${t(v.at)})`).join(", ")}</span>` : "");
}
const h = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1));
if (["All", ...COLLECTIVES].includes(h.get("tab"))) S.tab = h.get("tab");
const ok = d => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d || "");
if (ok(h.get("from")) && ok(h.get("to"))) setRange(h.get("from"), h.get("to")); else setRange(addDays(D.to, -44), D.to);
</script>
</body>
</html>
